metadata.description: Spotfire Skills Library (alpha): Agent Skills for building, styling, testing and versioning Spotfire DXPs with Claude Code.

plugins.name: spotfire-ingest
plugins.description: Read existing work (app prototypes, Excel calculation workbooks) and write the App Brief, Logic Spec and build spec that the build skills use.

plugins.name: spotfire-design
plugins.description: Decide what a Spotfire analysis must do for its users and how it behaves: App Brief framing, design rules and packaging.

plugins.name: spotfire-build
plugins.description: Produce a Spotfire DXP and its parts through the Spotfire API: generated IronPython builders, data functions, IronPython scripts, styling, visualization mods and action mods.

plugins.name: spotfire-testing
plugins.description: Run Spotfire Analyst unattended and test DXPs through the user interface with window screenshots after each step. Windows only.

plugins.name: spotfire-version-control
plugins.description: Update, track, check and compare DXPs with Git: automated data function updates, readable DXP diffs, CI on pull requests and library audits.

plugins.name: spotfire-reference
plugins.description: Lookups the other skills load when needed: proven Spotfire Analyst behaviour, naming standard, API index generator, Excel function map and the shared App Brief and Logic Spec formats.

plugins.name: spotfire-domain-context
plugins.description: Engineering knowledge for understanding an app's goal and checking its results: process time series analysis, midstream unit knowledge, synthetic process data and analytics models.
